item.title: Google Reduces Cost of Quantum Computing with Artificial Intelligence
item.dc:creator: Tech Habesha
item.description:
Google researchers have announced that they have significantly reduced the computational power required for quantum computers by combining artificial intelligence with mathematical verification methods.
According to the study, AI agents were able to reduce the computational resources required for nuclear fusion research by a factor of 10.9, photochemistry calculations by a factor of 8, and drug modification calculations by a factor of 2.5.
This discovery opens up new possibilities for solving more complex scientific problems in the fields of clean energy, drug discovery, and chemistry. Howev

item.title: ⌚ Galaxy Watch Reports Include Blisters
item.dc:creator: Tech Habesha
item.description:
One Galaxy Watch 5 Pro owner went to bed with a full charge and woke up to a dead watch and a blister. Other owners posted photos of red marks and fluid-filled blisters under the rear sensor block. Reports also mention the Galaxy Watch 7 and newer models.
The cause is unknown. Samsung says prolonged wear can cause discomfort, especially with sweat or infrequent cleaning. It advises removing the watch, cleaning the device and skin, and allowing several days to recover.

item.dc:creator: Tech Habesha
item.description: September 29 በ White House ላይ ከ ትልልቅ tech ኩባንያ መሪዎች ጋር morally binding (በ ሞራል አስገዳጅ) ያለውን AI ስምምነት መፈረሙን አስታውቋል ስምምነቱ የ ተፈረመው House Speaker Mike Johnson ባዘጋጀው luncheon (የ ምሳ ስብሰባ) ላይ ነው በ ስብሰባው ላይ Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang እና Tesla CEO Elon Musk ን ጨምሮ ብዙ tech ኮከቦች ተገኝተው ነበር ይሄ ስምምነት የ መጣው AI ደህንነት ላይ ያለው ስጋት እየጨመረ ባለበት ወቅት ነው ቀደም ብለን እንደ ተመለከትነው ትልልቅ AI ላቦራቶሪዎች (Anthropic OpenAI Google DeepMind) AI ልማት ትንሽ pacing (መቀዘቅዝ) አለበት ብለው ተስማምተው ነበር Trump ስለ ስምምነቱ ሲናገር tremendous self policing (ትልቅ ራስን መቆጣጠር) እያየ እንደ ሆነ ገልጿል Administration ው 10 ሰዎች ያሉት committee (ኮሚቴ) AI ኢንዱስትሪ
